[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Viruses are acellular and does not have any organelles
 
• They are not included in the five-kingdom classification.
 
• It is non-living and depends on the host.
 
• It consists of RNA or DNA as its genetic material.
 
• Virus means venom or poisonous fluid.
 
• The virus was discovered by Dmitri Ivanowsky.
 
• It causes disease in plants and animals like **Polio** in humans and **Tobacco Mosaic** in plants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An animal cell is eukaryotic in nature.
 
• It has a true nucleus.
 
• Animal cells have dsDNA.
 
• It is present inside the nucleus.
 
• It consists of genes that code for particular proteins and mRNA and thus control the cell functions.
 
• It contains outer cell membranes and membrane-bound organelles.
 
• The animal cell does not have any cell wall.
 
• It contains membrane-bound organelles such as mitochondria, Endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi, and lysosomes.
 
• It consists of a nucleus and it is present inside the double membrane.
 
• The nucleus is centrally located.
 
• It has Nuclear pores that allow the diffusion of a substance through it.
